one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform: funnels, email, automations, courses, products, affiliates.
access_notes: Keys are generated in-account from Settings → MCP & API keys.

evidence.quote: To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the X-API-Key header of each request.
Click on your profile picture and select Settings… click MCP & API keys… You can create up to 3 API keys per account.

Contacts… Tags… Newsletters… Campaigns… Funnels… Price plans and coupons… Courses… Community management… Automation rules… Subscriptions… Webhook management… Digital product… Physical product… Offers and sales settings… Calendar bookings… SMS templates.
Click Webhooks… Enter a name and a Webhook URL… Select the specific events that will trigger the webhook… Contact created… Opt-In… New sale… Sale canceled.
The MCP server is a powerful feature included in all systeme.io plans.
